description: Join us for a Book Release Blues Dance Party with LIVE MUSIC by Elnah Jordan!! Buy tickets here: https://events.humanitix.com/dangerous-r[...] 🎶 🎶 🎶 We don’t often get to experience three core pieces of Blues culture - live music, movement, and historical discussions - all at the same event... But that’s exactly what’s happening on September 19 at the Black & Tan Hall. 🎶 THE MUSIC: Join us for a live music set by Elnah Jordan, designed specifically for Blues dancers 💃 THE DANCE: We’ll be providing a lesson to introduce folks to Blues dance, followed by space for our community to actually dance to the live music 📖 THE HISTORY: Throughout the night, author T.J. English will be sharing from Dangerous Rhythms: Jazz and the Underworld - digging into the history, people, places, and forces that shaped Jazz and the world around it 📅 Saturday, September 19 📍 Black & Tan Hall 🎷 Live music by Elnah Jordan 📖 T.J. English presents his new book, "Dangerous Rhythms" 💃 Blues dance + open dance floor Come listen. Come learn. Come dance. 🎟️ https://events.humanitix.com/dangerous-r[...]
location: Black & Tan Hall, 5608 Rainier Ave S, Seattle, WA 98118, USA
title: Dangerous Rhythms LIVE! Blues Dance & Book Release Party Ft. Elnah Jordan

description:
We are returning to our usual 1A/B/C cadence in the fall! Sign up here: https://www.reverieballroom.com/class-ca[...]

Blues 1A: Jukin' is an intro-friendly, all-levels series designed to help brand-new dancers go from “I’ve never done this before” to confidently stepping onto the social dance floor. Along the way, we’ll explore dances that developed in Juke Joints across the United States - known globally as "Jukin' " Blues dances. Students will be introduced to a variety of Blues idiomatic dances and social dance skills.

Classes run on Wednesdays 8-9pm at the Emerald Ballroom at Reverie Ballroom.
